import novamind_api as nm

print("=== 1. WK15 LEADS & CONVERSION BY GROUP (start_day 99-105) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT group_id, status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 GROUP BY group_id, status ORDER BY group_id, status""")
agg = {}
for row in r['rows']:
    g = row['group_id']; agg.setdefault(g, {})[row['status']] = row['n']
for g, d in agg.items():
    tot = sum(d.values()); subbed = d.get('subscribed',0)+d.get('cancelled',0)
    print(f"  {g}: total={tot} subscribed={subbed} conv={subbed/tot*100:.1f}% detail={d}")

print("\n=== 2. WK15 NEW SUBS PLAN MIX ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT plan, COUNT(*) n, AVG(effective_price) avg_px FROM subscriptions
WHERE start_day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled') GROUP BY plan""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['plan']}: {row['n']} @ ${row['avg_px']:.0f}")

print("\n=== 3. WK11 COHORT (start 71-77) REBILL OUTCOME — by price ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT plan, listed_price, status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions
WHERE start_day BETWEEN 71 AND 77 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY plan, listed_price, status ORDER BY plan, listed_price""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['plan']} @${row['listed_price']:.0f} {row['status']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n=== 4. AD CHANNEL LEADS LAST 14 DAYS (marginal analysis) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT day, channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) leads, SUM(spend) spend
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>=92 GROUP BY day, channel_id, group_id ORDER BY day""")
from collections import defaultdict
wk = defaultdict(lambda: [0,0.0])
for row in r['rows']:
    w = 'wk14(92-98)' if row['day']<=98 else 'wk15(99-105)'
    key = (w, row['channel_id'], row['group_id'])
    wk[key][0]+=row['leads']; wk[key][1]+=row['spend']
for k in sorted(wk):
    L,S = wk[k]
    eff = L/S if S>0 else 0
    print(f"  {k[0]} {k[1]}-{k[2]}: {L} leads / ${S:.0f} = {eff:.4f} leads/$")

print("\n=== 5. ORGANIC vs PAID: total leads by day wk15 ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT start_day, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 GROUP BY start_day""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  day {row['start_day']}: {row['n']} leads")

print("\n=== 6. USAGE BY DAY (peak check) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) custs FROM daily_usage WHERE day>=99 GROUP BY day""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  day {row['day']}: {row['u']:,} units / {row['custs']} customers")

print("\n=== 7. LEDGER WK15 (99-105) BY CATEGORY ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt""")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']}: ${row['amt']:,.0f} ({row['n']} entries)")
    tot += row['amt']
print(f"  NET: ${tot:,.0f}")

print("\n=== 8. REBILLS vs NEW REVENUE WK15 ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger l WHERE day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 AND category='subscription_payment'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id = CAST(substr(l.note, instr(l.note,'customer ')+9) AS INTEGER))""")
# simpler: payments from subs that started in window = new
r2 = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.effective_price*s.seat_count) amt FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.start_day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 AND s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')""")
print(f"  new-sub first payments est: {r2['rows'][0]['n']} × avg = ${r2['rows'][0]['amt']:,.0f}")

print("\n=== 9. CANCELS THIS WEEK BY GROUP/COHORT ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price, s.start_day, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.end_day BETWEEN 99 AND 105 AND s.status='cancelled' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan, s.listed_price ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 15""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['group_id']} {row['plan']}@${row['listed_price']:.0f} start_d{row['start_day']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n=== 10. ISSUES HEALTH ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(day_opened) avgopen FROM issues WHERE day_resolved IS NULL""")
print(f"  open: {r['rows'][0]['n']}, avg day_opened: {r['rows'][0]['avgopen']:.1f} (today=105)")
